issue.body:

```python
from fastapi import Fastapi, File, Body, UploadFile
app = Fastapi()
@app.post('/test')
async def test(
        request: Request,
        file: UploadFile = File(None),
        keywords: str = Body(None, embed=True),
        name: str = Body(..., embed=True),
        default: bool = Body(..., embed=True)
):
    print(await request.body())
    return 1
```
